title: James Dolan, a Former Hochul Supporter, Goes All In on Her G.O.P. Rival
summary: The Knicks owner is urging New York’s business elite to abandon Gov. Kathy Hochul, highlighting her support of Mayor Zohran Mamdani. Mr. Dolan has spent millions to back her opponent, Bruce Blakeman.
